Package com.compdfkit.core.document

Class CPDFDocument

java.lang.Object
com.compdfkit.core.document.CPDFDocument
public class CPDFDocument extends Object
Document instance. One CPDFDocument object for one document. This class is used to represent a specified directory, which contains PDF files and user wants to search among these PDF files.

    • importPages

      public boolean importPages(CPDFDocument otherDocument, int start, int end, int insertPosition)
      Import page(s) from another document at the specified index point and insert to insertPosition.

      This is also the way to duplicate a page inside one file: open the same file as a second CPDFDocument and import the page from it. There is no separate copy-page or add-page API.

      Parameters:
      otherDocument - Other document.
      start - Start page index.
      end - End page index.
      insertPosition - Insert position.
      Returns:
      Returns whether to successfully import page(s).

      Add a signature to document.
      Parameters:

      password - Pkcs12 certificate file password

      Returns:

    • writeSignature

      public boolean writeSignature(CPDFSignatureWidget widget, String output, String certificate, String certificatePassword, String location, String reason, CPDFDocument.PDFDocMdpP permission, String tsaUrl)
      Signs an existing field using PKCS#12, optionally adding an embedded RFC 3161 timestamp.

      The document must be file-backed and the widget must belong to this document. The output must differ from the input, must not exist, and must have an existing writable parent directory. Reopen the output before inspecting its signature. This synchronous operation may contact a TSA and should run on a worker thread.

      This overload does not collect DSS/VRI evidence or establish an LT/LTA verdict. For the complete PAdES workflow, use CPDFPadesSigner.

      Parameters:
      widget - the valid signature widget belonging to this document
      output - the new signed-PDF path
      certificate - the PKCS#12 (.p12/.pfx) signer file path
      certificatePassword - the PKCS#12 password; null is treated as empty
      location - the signing location
      reason - the signing reason
      permission - the document modification permission to record
      tsaUrl - the RFC 3161 TSA URL; null or empty omits the embedded timestamp
      Returns:
      true if signing and output publication succeeded; false for invalid inputs or an operation failure
